title: Taking over the fireman-drummer's job and starting on vibraphone
summary: The previous drummer became a fire captain and gave him the drums and vibraphones; he left Roy's drums behind and began playing vibes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: I don't believe it. God was on your side, wasn't he?
He always has been. Always has been.
Fancy that.
And he gave me the --
So when you left Roy did you leave those drums, then, with him?
Yeah, I did leave them.
Yeah, cause he said that you did.
Yeah, he wanted them back.
Yeah.
Because it was his first instrument and he loved those drums.
Yes.
And I took good care of them.
Yeah.
I took care of them and he --
So then after that, this man -- vibes and everything?
Everything he gave me, and he went to work for the Fire Department. And --
What an extraordinary thing.
Uh-huh.
How marvelous.
And I just took over his job.
Oh, how thrilled you were, huh?
And that's when I started playing vibraphones. Because well, I said, 'I have this instrument, so I'm going to play it.'
